name: Magisters' Terrace
shortDescription: Magisters' Terrace, a Burning Crusade setting in the Shattered Sun research story.
body: Blood-elf dungeon on the Isle of Quel'Danas and setting of a TBC-side operation against Kael'thas. Its illustrated hall is original interpretive art, not a surveyed dungeon floor plan.
